input: Bug notes: the Android app TrailNotes crashes on launch on Android 14 when the device language is Turkish. Stack top: java.lang.NumberFormatException in LocaleUtils.parseCount(). Build 3.18.0, works on 3.17.2. Support ticket SUP-5531. Unrelated: the iOS widget color is slightly off, ignore that for this issue.

TrailNotes crashes at launch with a Turkish locale
- On Android 14, startup dies with a NumberFormatException thrown from LocaleUtils.parseCount().
- It started in 3.18.0; 3.17.2 is fine.
- Tracked in support ticket SUP-5531.

Launch crash when the phone language is Turkish
The app closes right after start on Android 14 because parseCount() in LocaleUtils raises a NumberFormatException. Version 3.18.0 is affected and the older 3.17.2 release is not. Please link ticket SUP-5531.
